main.name: Md Zubair Saleem
main.description: Backend Systems · FastAPI & Python · LLM Workflows
main.bio: I got into software engineering because I love understanding how systems function under the hood and the thrill of turning ideas into real products. Right now at Teclusion AI, I build production REST APIs with FastAPI, optimize databases across PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and wire LLM pipelines into real workflows. When I'm not writing APIs, you'll find me exploring Agentic AI, building side projects, or drinking too much chai ☕.
main.contactmessage: I'm always excited to talk about backend systems, AI workflows, or full-time software engineering roles. My inbox is always open.

education.description: Graduated with 7.5 CGPA. Focused on data structures, distributed systems, and backend development.

work.title: Software Engineer
work.summary: Building production backend services and AI pipelines rather than just internal demos. Taking full ownership of API reliability, query speed, and test coverage.
bullets: Designed, tested, and shipped production REST API services using Python and FastAPI with strict Pydantic v2 validation.
Wired LLM-powered pipelines into backend logic using LangChain and Gemini APIs for automated data analysis.
Optimized PostgreSQL and MongoDB queries, reducing latency by ~15% across key endpoints.
Containerized microservices with Docker, configured Kubernetes deployments, and automated testing with Playwright and PyTest.

projects.title: Dynamic Rule Engine API System
projects.challenge: Hardcoded business logic slows teams down and requires constant redeployments. I wanted an engine that evaluates business rules dynamically via REST APIs without downtime.
projects.howIBuiltIt: Built a modular FastAPI service using abstract syntax tree (AST) parsing, strict Pydantic schemas, and exhaustive PyTest suites.
projects.takeaway: Learned deep AST parsing and how to build bulletproof data validation layers against invalid expression evaluation.
projects.mobileSummary: Dynamic rule evaluation engine built with FastAPI and AST parsing. Evaluates custom business logic on the fly without code redeployments.
bullets: Built a FastAPI rule engine for evaluating dynamic business rules through REST endpoints.
Implemented AST rule parsing, validation, and safe evaluation workflows.

projects.title: AI Food Ordering & Diet Recommendation
projects.challenge: Most food apps recommend popular dishes, not what fits your personal health constraints or diet goals. I wanted to see if AI could make ordering tailored to nutrition.
projects.howIBuiltIt: Integrated Gemini LLM with LangChain inside a React, Node.js, and MongoDB stack to generate structured dietary meal plans with instant cart synchronization.
projects.takeaway: Discovered that prompt architecture and strict JSON schemas matter far more than model size when grounding AI into eCommerce logic.
projects.mobileSummary: Full-stack food ordering app powered by Gemini & LangChain that personalizes meal orders based on health and dietary requirements.
bullets: Integrated Gemini LLM with LangChain for context-aware dietary meal recommendations.
Built full-stack React + Node.js interface with real-time cart and nutritional calculations.

projects.title: Multiple Disease Prediction System
projects.challenge: Predictive healthcare models are often buried in Jupyter notebooks. I wanted an interactive, accessible diagnostic tool clinicians or users could test in seconds.
projects.howIBuiltIt: Trained machine learning classification models on clinical patient datasets (~92% accuracy) and built an interactive Streamlit UI for immediate parameter analysis.
projects.takeaway: Mastered feature scaling, handling class imbalances, and translating raw ML models into intuitive interactive software.
projects.mobileSummary: Interactive ML diagnostic assistant predicting multiple conditions with ~92% accuracy, deployed live on Streamlit.
bullets: Trained classification models achieving ~92% accuracy on clinical biometric datasets.
Designed interactive Streamlit web dashboard for real-time risk predictions.

projects.title: Learning Management System (LMS)
projects.challenge: Educational platforms can be bloated. I wanted a lightweight, modular system for student enrollments and course tracking.
projects.howIBuiltIt: Constructed responsive React components with secure JWT authentication and clean Node/Express endpoints for student progress tracking.
projects.takeaway: Gained solid experience in state management, session handling, and clean modular REST design.
projects.mobileSummary: Modular educational portal with JWT authentication, course cataloging, and student enrollment tracking.
bullets: Engineered course catalog and student enrollment interface with authentication.
Implemented RESTful endpoints for lesson progress and user verification.

projects.title: Real-Time Currency Exchange Engine
projects.challenge: Building a zero-delay conversion utility with live forex rate updates and responsive mobile UX.
projects.howIBuiltIt: Integrated live ExchangeRate APIs with asynchronous state updates and clean CSS styling.
projects.takeaway: Deepened understanding of asynchronous DOM events and third-party API error fallbacks.
projects.mobileSummary: Fast currency converter featuring real-time forex rate calculations and instantaneous rate swapping.
bullets: Integrated live exchange rate APIs with asynchronous calculations.
Lightweight client-side UI with instant swap functionality.
